claims.statement: PPWR applies generally from 12 August 2026, covers all packaging regardless of material or origin, and introduces requirements spanning manufacture, composition, reuse or recoverability, waste management, labeling, and phased recyclability goals.
The Commission issued implementation guidance in March 2026 and an FAQ in August 2026, indicating active interpretation work around practical business questions.

Packaging converters are a plausible event-triggered distribution point because each material or artwork change already passes through them, but their appetite to resell an independent evidence layer is unknown.

contrary_evidence: Important recyclability and recycled-content deadlines are phased toward 2030 and later, reducing immediate urgency for some SKUs.
Large brands and converters already maintain regulatory and packaging-development teams.
Delegated acts, national EPR implementation, and laboratory methods can continue to change, raising maintenance cost.

economics.acquisition_route: Embed a compliance-packet line item in converter quotes and artwork-approval portals: every new die line or material substitution creates a scoped evidence check before print approval. The converter earns recurring service revenue while the brand gets a maintained record rather than a one-off consultancy PDF.
economics.founder_time: Part-time validation hypothesis; delivery burden remains untested.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Converter workflow integrations, versioned rule logic, reusable supplier evidence, lab handoffs, and approval audit trails reduce repeated chases and prevent obsolete artwork. The advantage is controlled change execution across participants, not the raw document store.
fingerprint.customer: CEE FMCG and private-label brands plus packaging converters managing hundreds or thousands of food, personal-care, or household-product SKUs across EU markets.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Embed a compliance-packet line item in converter quotes and artwork-approval portals: every new die line or material substitution creates a scoped evidence check before print approval. The converter earns recurring service revenue while the brand gets a maintained record rather than a one-off consultancy PDF.
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Build a versioned packaging bill of materials, collect supplier declarations and test reports, map phased PPWR requirements, flag missing evidence and upcoming redesign dates, and produce controlled approval packets for brand, converter, and retailer. Start with one packaging family and do not imply that every 2030 rule is already due.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The brand pays per initial SKU evidence pack and an annual portfolio subscription; each material or artwork change triggers a smaller re-check fee, with lab testing and legal opinions passed through transparently.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A packaging redesign, new material quote, retailer tender, artwork change, supplier substitution, or PPWR application milestone requires the brand to prove which composition, recyclability, labeling, substance, and reuse obligations apply to each SKU and date.

founder_fit: Exceptionally strong founder fit with FMCG context, data structuring, automation, business analysis, and AI document extraction.
Can be validated with a narrow packaging type and no inventory or public personal brand.
Employer conflict and confidentiality are material; all testing must use independently recruited firms and public rules, not workplace data.
risks: Evidence of a workflow, transition, or loss does not yet establish recurring willingness to pay.
The proposed distribution and compounding mechanisms remain hypotheses pending buyer evidence.

title: PPWR Packaging Evidence and Change-Control Desk
uncertainties: Which packaging family has the highest evidence pain and lowest incumbent-tool penetration in CEE.
Per-SKU review time after supplier documents are normalized and the sustainable price point.
Liability allocation when a supplier declaration or rule interpretation is wrong.
Pricing, buyer authority, and acquisition economics remain unvalidated at discovery.

First validation test: Audit 100 SKUs from one independent brand and one converter in a single packaging family, charging for the portfolio map. Measure missing evidence, conflicting declarations, and review time; seek a converter agreement that automatically offers the check on ten new quotes, and continue only if at least five customers pay for the packet.
